Name: Flaming Dart
Effects: Deals 1 point of fire damage to a single target.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Melee Reach (3 Mana)

Name: Ember Flick
Effects: Deals 1 point of fire damage on contact.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Touch (2 Mana), Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Extremely minor damage but reliable. • Often used to ignite small fires. • Ineffective against armored foes.
Flavor Line: A spark in the palm can sting like a whip.

Name: Heat Veil
Effects: Grants +5% fire resistance or +1 Fortitude stat for 1 step.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Buff (2 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Self (1 Mana), Duration: Combat Step (2 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Protective effect fades quickly. • Stacks poorly with other resistance sources. • Cannot be extended beyond 1 step at Apprentice level.
Flavor Line: A shimmer of heat shields the daring from the flame.

Name: Scorching Ray
Effects: Deals 2 points of fire damage to a single target.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (6 Mana for 2 points)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana), Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Burns cause lingering pain and may ignite clothing. • Still weak against heavily armored foes. • More effective at short range than long.
Flavor Line: A line of fire carves through the air, scorching whatever it touches.

Name: Flame Wall
Effects: Creates a 30 ft wall of fire that inflicts 1 point of fire damage to any creature passing through.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana), Shape: Wall (4 Mana), Duration: Combat Step (2 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Burns are minor but unavoidable if passed through. • Provides light and intimidation even outside combat. • Ineffective in wide-open areas with no need for barriers.
Flavor Line: A wall of fire erupts, daring any foe to cross through the flames.

Name: Cinder Burst
Effects: Deals 1 point of fire damage to all creatures within a 10 ft radius of the burst.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana), Shape: Radius (3 Mana), Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana), Scaling for AoE potency (3 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Embers may ignite flammable terrain or objects. • Minor damage but useful for revealing hidden foes. • More intimidating than lethal.
Flavor Line: A crackle of heat scatters sparks like wildfire across the battlefield.

Name: Inferno Wave
Effects: Deals 2 points of fire damage to all creatures in a 30 ft cone; targets struck must roll to avoid being knocked prone by the heat blast.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (6 Mana) → Knockdown rider (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana), Shape: Cone (3 Mana), Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana), Scaling damage potency (7 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Fire persists for 1 step on flammable terrain. • Visibility reduced by smoke. • Very risky to cast in enclosed spaces. • Terrifies most mundane creatures.
Flavor Line: A roaring tide of fire floods forward, leaving only scorched earth and silence.

Name: Pyroclasm
Effects: Deals 3 points of fire damage on impact and creates burning terrain (1 damage per step if crossed).
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (9 Mana for 3 points) → Create Terrain Effect (12 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Long (7 Mana), Shape: Sphere/Zone (5 Mana), Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Creates difficult terrain for the duration. • Secondary burns may spread. • Enemies may panic from the sudden eruption. • High mana demand requires caution.
Flavor Line: A volcanic eruption tears the battlefield apart in flame and molten stone.

Name: Phoenix Surge
Effects: Deals 3 points of fire damage to all creatures in a 20 ft radius burst, centered at chosen point within sight.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (9 Mana for 3 points)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10 Mana), Shape: Radius (6 Mana), Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana), Scaling potency & scope (13 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Briefly illuminates entire battlefield. • Fire may spread outward from the point of impact. • Requires open line of sight — ineffective underground. • Causes awe and fear even in allies.
Flavor Line: A blazing phoenix erupts into the sky, scattering fire across all it surveys.

Name: Hellstorm Crucible
Effects: Inflicts 4 fire damage per round within zone; Control effects include Grapple/Restrain as the fiery winds lash targets and Immobilize for those who fail their saves.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (12 Mana for 4 points) II. Control (2 Mana) → Grapple/Restrain (4 Mana) + Immobilize (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10 Mana), Shape: Sphere/Zone (11 Mana), Duration: 2 Combat Rounds (10 Mana), Scaling/zone intensity (17 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Burning terrain persists even after spell ends. • High chance of suffocation or panic due to ash. • Can collapse structures from prolonged exposure. • Survivors often scarred permanently. • Casting visibly alters sky/weather for miles.
Flavor Line: Flame cascades like rain from a molten sky, imprisoning all within a crucible of living fire.

Name: Infernal Maelstrom
Effects: Deals 4 fire damage per round; Control effects include Pull (10 ft each step) and Knockdown on failed saves; lingering flames cause 2 extra damage after spell ends.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (12 Mana for 4 points) II. Control (2 Mana) → Pull (3 Mana) + Knockdown (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana), Shape: Sphere/Zone (9 Mana), Duration: 2 Combat Rounds (10 Mana) + Lingering (2 Mana), Scaling intensity (33 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Creates a sustained vortex of flame that moves objects and terrain debris. • Pull effect can drag flying creatures from the sky. • Risk of suffocation from heat and smoke. • Lingering fire zones can cut off escape paths. • Environmental devastation can spread if uncontrolled.
Flavor Line: A spiraling inferno tears across the field, dragging foes into a roaring vortex of living flame.

Name: Worldfire Convergence
Effects: All targets inside take 10 fire damage per round; Nested Temporal/Spatial container inside AoE imposes Decelerate (-2 initiative steps); Separate Control container inflicts Grapple/Restrain and Anchor/Lock on targets near the edges, pulling them inward.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (30 Mana for 10 points) + Nested Temporal/Spatial (5 Mana) → Control: Decelerate (8 Mana for -2 steps) II. Control (2 Mana) → Grapple/Restrain (4 Mana) + Anchor/Lock (6 Mana) III. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana) (focused dart of fire at caster’s choice)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10 Mana), Shape: Sphere/Zone (25 Mana), Duration: 3 Combat Rounds (15 Mana) + Lingering (2 Mana), Scaling (59 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: The spell leaves entire landscapes scarred for centuries. • Grappled targets pulled inward risk being immolated instantly. • Slowed initiative makes escape nearly impossible. • Allies risk capture if inside radius. • Caster must pass backlash save or collapse into unconsciousness. • Known as a “world-ender” spell in lore.
Flavor Line: The world itself ignites, time slows, and chains of flame drag all things into the burning heart of oblivion.

Name: Stone Pebble
Effects: Deals 1 point of blunt damage with a magically propelled stone.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Melee Reach (3 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Base spell deals minor damage and can chip or distract foes. • Narratively useful for training or intimidation. • Damage type = blunt, environmental.
Flavor Line: A flicked stone becomes a weapon—and, in time, a cataclysm.
Progressive spell conditions: Apprentice: 1 damage pebble, Melee Reach (5–10 ft). Novice: +Per Success scaling; 1 damage per success, range increases to Short (30 ft). Master: Stone Barrage; Multi-Target up to 3, each hit 2 damage, range increases to Medium (60 ft). High Master: Boulder impact; AoE Radius (10 ft), 3 damage per target, may knock foes prone, range increases to Long (120 ft). Grand Master: Meteor stones; AoE Sphere (30 ft), 5 damage per target, terrain shatters on impact, usable at Line of Sight.

Name: Earthen Grip
Effects: Restricts target’s movement for 1 step.
Container Breakdown: Control (2) → Grapple/Restrain (4)
Add ons: Range: Melee Reach (3), Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Works only on solid ground (not ice, sand, or liquid). • Targets may break free with sufficient strength. • Commonly used to stall attackers closing into melee.
Flavor Line: Hands of soil clutch tight, dragging the reckless to stillness.

Name: Stone Skin
Effects: Provides +1 armor/soak against physical attacks for 1 round.
Container Breakdown: Target (1) → Buff (2)
Add ons: Range: Self (1), Duration: Combat Round (5)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Stone skin is visibly brittle, cracking when struck. • Reduces flexibility and agility slightly. • Crumbles into dust when the duration ends.
Flavor Line: The caster’s flesh takes on the weight of mountains, for a moment as enduring as stone.

Name: Stone Spikes
Effects: Deals 1 point of piercing damage per target in the line.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana), Shape: Line (3 Mana), Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Spikes remain as terrain hazards. • Damage type = piercing, environmental. • Targets may attempt save to avoid prone condition.
Flavor Line: Lines of jagged earth tear upward, turning ground into a deadly hazard.

Name: Earthen Grasp
Effects: Restrains a single target for 1 combat step.
Container Breakdown: I. Control (2 Mana) → Grapple/Restrain (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana), Duration: Combat Step (2 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Target is restrained for 1 step. • Opposed roll may allow escape. • Concentration required to sustain beyond base duration.
Flavor Line: The earth itself clutches, dragging foes to stillness.

Name: Rock Armor
Effects: Grants +3 Soak for duration.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Buff (+3 Soak, 6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Self (1 Mana), Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Armor is cumbersome; caster’s movement halved. • Provides resistance to piercing and slashing damage. • Cannot be stacked with other Buff-type armor spells.
Flavor Line: The ground itself rises to shield the mage in a carapace of stone.

Name: Stone Spire
Effects: Deals 4 points of piercing/blunt damage and creates a 10 ft high spire of stone at target location.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (12 Mana, 4 points) II. Control (2 Mana) → Immobilize (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Targets hit may be impaled, requiring a save to avoid critical injury. • Terrain is altered; spire provides half-cover for 1 round. • Immobilize effect pins creature if spire erupts directly beneath them. • Caster may use spire as anchor point for future spells (G.O.D discretion).
Flavor Line: The earth screams upward in defiance, raising a stone fang from the soil.

Name: Earthen Grasp
Effects: Restrains a single target and deals 2 points of crushing damage each round for the duration.
Container Breakdown: I. Control (2 Mana) → Grapple/Restrain (4 Mana) + Damage (6 Mana, 2 pts) II. Target (1 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana) Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Target is restrained, immobilized for the duration unless they succeed a Strength save. • Deals 2 damage each round while grasp holds. • Hands remain for 1 round, fading back into earth afterward. • Terrain at the spot is left rough and unstable.
Flavor Line: Stone clenches like a giant fist, crushing flesh and bone with patient inevitability.

Name: Stone Maelstrom
Effects: Deals 3 damage to all creatures within a 20 ft radius. Creatures caught inside must save vs. Strength or be knocked prone. Creates difficult terrain that persists briefly after the storm ends.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (9 Mana) II. Control (2 Mana) → Knockdown (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana), Shape: Radius 20 ft (5 Mana), Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Deals 3 blunt/piercing damage per creature in radius. • Knockdown save required for all creatures caught inside. • Difficult terrain persists 1 round after spell ends. • Cannot be cast without a solid earthen/stone surface. • Vision obscured inside the maelstrom.
Flavor Line: The ground itself rises in fury, shredding foes in a storm of stone.

Name: Continental Rift
Effects: Deals 5 damage to all creatures caught in the fissure line. Targets must save vs. Dexterity or fall prone into the rift, suffering an additional 2 damage and becoming restrained until freed.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (15 Mana for 5 damage) II. Control (2 Mana) → Restrain (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Long (7 Mana), Shape: Line 60 ft (3 +6 = 9 Mana), Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Modifiers: Backlash Risk (–5 Mana); Environmental Dependency (–3 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Rift creates a 10 ft wide chasm along its path that persists until magically repaired. • Collapsing ground counts as difficult terrain for all. • Failed saves drag creatures into the rift, restraining them. • Casting failure risks collapse of ground beneath caster. • Structures caught in line automatically take 10 structural damage.
Flavor Line: The land itself revolts, splitting open with unstoppable force.

Name: Avalanche
Effects: Deals 4 damage to all creatures within the avalanche path. Targets must save vs. Strength or be buried, suffering 1 additional damage per round until freed.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (12 Mana for 4 damage) II. Control (2 Mana) → Immobilize (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Long (7 Mana), Shape: Wall 60 ft (4 +4 = 8 Mana), Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Avalanche buries terrain in debris, making affected zones difficult terrain. • Buried creatures restrained until allies free them. • Structures struck collapse without magical reinforcement. • Requires a mountainside, cliff, or large rock mass to trigger. • Environmental devastation can alter local geography.
Flavor Line: A wave of the mountain itself surges downward, unstoppable and absolute.

Name: Worldshaper’s Bastion
Effects: Summons a massive fortress-like structure of stone that shields allies and imprisons foes. Within its walls, enemies suffer 4 damage per round from crushing stone pressure while allies gain +4 defense. Terrain permanently altered.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Summon (major, 15 Mana) + Create/Destroy (major, 12 Mana)  Nested Container: Control (2 Mana) → Immobilize (6 Mana) + Damage (12 Mana for 4 damage)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10 Mana), Shape: Zone 300 ft (5 +15 = 20 Mana), Duration: Lingering 3 rounds (2+2+2 = 6 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Allies inside gain +4 Defense as walls shield them. • Enemies caught inside must save vs. Strength or be immobilized, taking 4 crushing damage per round. • Terrain is permanently reshaped into fortress structures unless dispelled. • If the caster loses concentration, the Bastion collapses violently, dealing 6 damage to all inside. • Casting this spell drains the caster physically, leaving 1 permanent Constitution loss. • Structures created can serve as real fortifications after combat.
Flavor Line: A citadel of stone rises in an instant, the world itself bowing to the caster’s command.

Name: Gust of Renewal
Effects: Shoves a single adjacent target 10 ft; clears smoke, dust, or small flames.
Container Breakdown: I. Control (2 Mana) → Push (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Self (1 Mana); Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Cannot move targets larger/heavier than the caster at Apprentice. • Clears only light materials at this tier.
Flavor Line: The breath of the world, focused into your hand.
Progressive spell conditions: Apprentice: Push 1 adjacent target 10 ft; clears light debris/smoke. • Novice: Push up to 2 targets (Multi-Target +3), shove extends to 20 ft; disperses fog/obscurants. • Master: Cone (30 ft; +3 Mana base +2 per 10 ft), knockdown check required, can disrupt projectiles. • High Master: 60 ft cone or 40 ft radius burst, hurls medium creatures, imposes –10% accuracy penalty, extinguishes fires. • Grand Master: Tornado-force blast (120 ft cone or 100 ft radius), uproots trees/structures, launches large creatures, battlefield-wide visibility disruption.

Name: Cutting Draft
Effects: Deals 1 point of slashing damage to a single target; may sever rope, parchment, or other fragile bindings.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Damage is superficial unless enhanced by other effects. • Cannot cut metal, bone, or hardened armor. • G.O.D may allow automatic severing of loose cords or light fabric.
Flavor Line: The air itself sharpens to your will.

Name: Air Needle
Effects: Deals 1 point of slashing (wind) damage to a single target; may sever light bindings (rope, fabric, parchment).
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Cannot cut metal or hardened armor. • If used to sever, G.O.D adjudicates thickness/quality of material.
Flavor Line: The edge of the wind is the edge of will.

Name: Suffocating Grasp
Effects: Target loses breath: immobilized for 1 step, may panic or drop held items.
Container Breakdown: I. Control (2 Mana) → Immobilize (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana); Duration: Combat Step (2 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Target resists with Constitution or Willpower (G.O.D discretion). • Does not deal direct damage, but may stagger or drop items. • Ineffective against constructs/undead.
Flavor Line: The air in your lungs belongs to me.

Name: Wind Step
Effects: Caster surges up to 20 ft in a straight line and gains +1 Initiative step this round.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Accelerate / Hasten (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Self (1 Mana); Duration: Combat Step (2 Mana); Movement Boost (3 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Movement must be along a clear path; cannot pass through barriers. • Treated as enhanced dash, not teleportation. • If restrained, spell fails.
Flavor Line: To run with the wind is to outrun fate itself.

Name: Whispering Zephyr
Effects: Carry one short verbal message to chosen target within range.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Illusion / Mask (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Message limited to ~10 words. • Cannot pass through airtight barriers. • May be overheard if intercepted by magical detection.
Flavor Line: Every breeze has a secret to tell.

Name: Cyclone Prison
Effects: Enemies are restrained in swirling wind, take 2 points damage per round, movement halved.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Control (2 Mana) → Grapple/Restrain (4 Mana) + Damage (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana); Shape: Sphere Zone (8 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Affected creatures may attempt Strength or Will saves each round to escape. • Severe weather amplifies damage. • Can extinguish flames within the zone. • May scatter missiles/arrows passing through.
Flavor Line: A cage woven of storm, tighter with every breath.

Name: Suffocating Dome
Effects: A dome of still air removes breath: targets inside begin suffocating, lose ability to speak, and take 1 vitality damage per round.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Control (2 Mana) → Silence (5 Mana) + Immobilize (6 Mana) + Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana); Shape: Sphere Zone (11 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Each round, creatures must save vs Constitution or gain 1 fatigue. • Verbal spellcasting is impossible within the dome. • Fires are immediately extinguished inside. • At dome’s collapse, air rushes back violently, possibly staggering creatures (G.O.D discretion).
Flavor Line: In stillness, even the wind denies your breath.

Name: Tempest Barrage
Effects: A cone of cutting wind and storm: 3 points damage per target, chance to knockdown, minor electrical burns.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (9 Mana) + Control: Knockdown (4 Mana)

Flavor Line: The storm is not called—it is unleashed.

Name: Storm Nexus
Effects: A swirling storm that deals 3 damage per round, imposes knockdown checks, and inflicts –10% accuracy.

Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana); Shape: Sphere Zone (11 Mana); Duration: 2 Combat Rounds (10 Mana)

Flavor Line: To call the storm is to wager your soul against the sky.

Name: Storm Nexus
Effects: A swirling storm that deals 3 damage per round, imposes knockdown checks, and inflicts –10% accuracy.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Container: Control (2 Mana) → Knockdown (4 Mana) + Damage (9 Mana) → Nested Container: Temporal/Spatial (5 Mana) + Spatial Bubble (8 Mana)

Flavor Line: To call the storm is to wager your soul against the sky.

Name: Worldstorm
Effects: A reality-rending storm that reshapes terrain, scatters armies, and devastates all within. Deals 5 damage per round, knocks creatures prone, imposes fatigue, and alters environment permanently.
Container Breakdown: I. Temporal/Spatial (5 Mana) → Create/Destroy Major (12 Mana) → Nested: AoE (2 Mana) + Damage (15 Mana) → Nested: Control (2 Mana) + Knockdown (4 Mana) + Debuff (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10 Mana); Shape: Sphere Zone (20 Mana); Duration: 3 Combat Rounds (15 Mana) + Lingering (10 Mana)

Flavor Line: The storm does not come—you become the storm.

Name: Aqua Lash
Effects: Deals 1 point of water/impact damage on touch; may douse small flames.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Touch (2 Mana); Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Extinguishes candles/small flames on contact; surfaces become damp/slippery at G.O.D. discretion; resistance/wards may reduce effect.
Flavor Line: The first cut of the tide is a whisper before the wave.

Name: Ripple Shot
Effects: Deals 1 point of water/impact damage.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Short (4 Mana); Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Extinguishes small flames; dampens terrain; light armor may reduce impact.
Flavor Line: A ripple carries farther than you think.

Name: Soothing Stream
Effects: Heals 1 point of vitality.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Healing (3 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Touch (2 Mana); Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Heals only minor wounds; concentration required; water lingers after use.
Flavor Line: A stream soothes more than thirst.

Name: Tide Push
Effects: Shoves all targets in cone 10 ft backward.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana), II. Control (2 Mana) → Push (3 Mana)
Add ons: Shape: Cone (30 ft) (3 Mana); Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Extinguishes flames, drenches terrain, creates slippery footing.
Flavor Line: The tide rolls forward, and all must yield.

Name: Charged Grasp
Effects: Deals 2 lightning damage.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (6 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Touch (2 Mana); Duration: Instantaneous (1 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Requires conductive medium; may arc to nearby surfaces; melee risk.
Flavor Line: Water carries more than life — it carries the storm.

Name: Bubble Veil
Effects: Buff: +15% damage resistance; halves fire damage.

Add ons: Range: Self (1 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Reduces physical/elemental damage; fire damage halved; breaks if concentration lost.
Flavor Line: Every bubble is a shield, every ripple a ward.

Name: Riptide Grasp
Effects: Deals 2 water damage and Restrains target.
Container Breakdown: I. Target (1 Mana) → Damage (6 Mana), II. Control (2 Mana) → Grapple/Restrain (4 Mana)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Restrains for 1 round; deals damage on impact; creates slick terrain near target.
Flavor Line: Water is the softest element — until it decides to hold you down.

Name: Stormcall Surge
Effects: 3 lightning damage per target each round; Spatial Bubble slows movement and disrupts ranged actions.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (9 Mana), II. Temporal/Spatial (5 Mana) → Spatial Bubble (8 Mana)
Add ons: Shape: Sphere (20 ft) (5 Mana); Range: Long (7 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Modifiers: Environmental Dependency (-3 Mana), Backlash Risk (-5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Backlash possible; requires storm conditions; movement halved and ranged actions impaired.
Flavor Line: The storm does not strike — it *inhabits*.

Name: Tide Wall
Effects: Creates 30 ft wall of water; anchors projectiles; halves fire damage; collapses into slick terrain.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Create/Destroy (major, 12 Mana), II. Control (2 Mana) → Anchor/Lock (6 Mana), + Buff (4 Mana, fire resistance)
Add ons: Shape: Wall (30 ft) (4 Mana); Range: Short (4 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)
Notes/Special Conditions: Anchors projectiles, halves fire damage, collapses to terrain hazard after 1 round.
Flavor Line: The sea rises not just to shield, but to fight for you.

Name: Maelstrom Vortex
Effects: Deals 4 water damage per round; pulls targets 10 ft inward; immobilizes at center; movement halved inside.
Container Breakdown: I. AoE (2 Mana) → Damage (12 Mana), II. Control (2 Mana) → Pull (3 Mana) + Immobilize (6 Mana), III. Temporal/Spatial (5 Mana) → Spatial Bubble (8 Mana)
Add ons: Shape: Sphere (30 ft) (8 Mana); Range: Long (7 Mana); Duration: Combat Round (5 Mana)

Name: Ancestral Aegis
Effects: Gain +5% to checks resisting fear, panic, possession, or similar spirit influence for the current combat step; your soul signature is lightly veiled against casual detection.
Container Breakdown: Container 1: Target (1) → Stand Alone: Buff (+5% vs fear/possession) (2)
Add ons: Range: Self (1); Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Does not compel courage—only reduces interference and sharpens intent. • Veil hinders only casual/brief soul reads; focused rituals ignore this. • Multiple castings don’t stack; take the strongest.
Flavor Line: “Stand where your ancestors stood, and fear will blink first.”

Name: Lifethread Gift
Effects: Transfer 1 point of vitality from the caster to a touched willing ally instantly; cannot reduce the caster below 1 HP; counts as healing for interactions.
Container Breakdown: Container 1: Target (1) → Stand Alone: Transfer Life Force (1 point) (4)

Notes/Special Conditions: • Only transfers from caster → ally; no siphoning from foes. • Fails if target is warded against soul contact or is unwilling. • Cannot stabilize the dead; use before an ally drops.
Flavor Line: “Better a scar on me than a grave for you.”

Name: Echo of Emotion

Container Breakdown: Container 1: AoE (2) → Stand Alone: Reveal/Detect (4)
Add ons: Range: Short (4); Duration: Combat Round (5)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Does not reveal specific thoughts or memories. • Powerful wards or soulless constructs return no result. • Emotional noise may overwhelm in large groups; G.O.D discretion for clarity.
Flavor Line: “The heart cannot lie to the soul.”

Name: Soul Bind

Name: Warden’s Lantern
Effects: Reveals hidden/invisible spiritual presences and highlights weak points in ethereal constructs within 15 ft zone.

Flavor Line: “The soul can be heavier than iron.”

Name: Guardian Spirit

Name: Pale Legion

Flavor Line: “The dead march where the living falter.”

Progressive spell conditions: Apprentice: Touch heals 1 HP, +5% resilience (1 step). • Novice: Heal 2 HP, cleanse poison/disease, duration 1 round. • Master: Heal 3 HP to up to 3 allies, +1 Constitution, duration 1 round. • High Master: Heal 5 HP per ally in 20 ft radius, ward against ailments, duration 1 hour. • Grand Master: Heal 10 HP per ally in 100 ft sphere, restore lost Constitution, revive 1 fallen ally, +2 Constitution and curse immunity, duration 1 day.

Flavor Line: “In clean light, the body remembers how to fight.”

Flavor Line: “From a single seed, an army may rise.”

Flavor Line: “Death is but a pause in the great cycle.”

Flavor Line: “The grave breathes out its lesson through your hand.”

Name: Wailing Legion

Name: Gleam

Effects: Marks an object with a traceable arcane seal.

Effects: Bind one valid, active enchantment to a touched item as a permanent property; create a small isolation field during sealing; convert the target effect’s duration to innate; result resists standard dispels (suppression only at G.O.D. discretion).

Name: Arsenal Field

Flavor Line: “Sharpen the moment, and the steel will follow.”

Flavor Line: “Hold what you are for a heartbeat longer—and let history fit your hand.”

Name: Grasp of the Pale Host
Effects: All creatures in radius must save or be Grappled/Restrained; on failure they also take 4 psychic damage and –10% to all rolls; warped space presses on everyone caught.
Container Breakdown: Containers: AoE (2) + Control (2) + Temporal/Spatial (5); Stand-Alones inside: Grapple/Restrain (4), Damage (4 = 9), Debuff (–10% = 3), Illusion/Mask (4), Spatial Bubble (8)
Add ons: Shape: Radius 40 ft (9) + Range: Long (7) + Duration: 2 Combat Rounds (10)
Modifiers: Environmental Dependency (–3; requires shadow or dim light for full effect)
Notes/Special Conditions: * Psychic damage ignores armor soaks. * On save, target avoids Grapple but still feels the bubble’s pressure (narrative hindrance). * In bright light, illusions loosen their grip (advantage on saves at G.O.D. discretion). * Multiple casts don’t stack; take the worse penalty.
Flavor Line: “The pale arms of the forgotten rise to welcome you.”

Name: Nightmare Dominion
Effects: All enemies in sphere must save or be Immobilized; on success they still suffer –20% accuracy and –3 Initiative. Each round they take 8 psychic damage and suffer –3 CON while the domain persists. Illusions manifest as personal nightmares, warping perception and resolve.
Container Breakdown: Containers: AoE (2) + Control (2) + Temporal/Spatial (5); Stand-Alones inside: Immobilize (6), Debuff (–20% = 5), Decelerate/Slow (–3 Init = 6), Damage (8 = 17), Debuff (–3 CON = 4), Illusion/Mask (4), Spatial Bubble (8)
Add ons: Shape: Sphere 100 ft (11) + Range: Line of Sight (10) + Duration: 3 Rounds (15) + Lingering (3 steps = 6)
Modifiers: Backlash Risk (–5; if triggered, bard takes 5 psychic damage and –1 Will for 1 step) + Environmental Dependency (–3; requires soundscape/echo)
Notes/Special Conditions: * Saves negate Immobilize but not the ongoing penalties/damage. * –3 CON is fixed for the duration (G.O.D. may narrate it as draining across the rounds). * Allies inside feel unease; on a save they avoid penalties but may suffer –5% to one roll at G.O.D. discretion. * Spatial Bubble makes movement feel heavy and distorted.
Flavor Line: “The world does not end in silence—it ends in fear.”

Name: Spark of Wrath
Effects: Target gains +5% accuracy and +1 damage for 1 step.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) → Stand-Alone: Buff (+5% rolls = 2) + Buff (+1 damage = 2).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Touch (2), Duration Combat Step (2).
Notes/Special Conditions: Designed as a low-risk combat primer; great prelude before bigger buffs; visible as a faint red pulse in veins.
Flavor Line: “The spark that turns restraint into action.”

Name: Heckle
Effects: Target suffers –5% accuracy until the end of the current step.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) → Stand-Alone: Debuff (–5% = 2).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Short (4), Duration Instantaneous (1).
Notes/Special Conditions: No effect on mindless or emotionless targets; narrative taunts encouraged; cannot impose Control without paying Control costs.
Flavor Line: “A single word, sharp enough to draw blood without a blade.”

Name: Ember of Fury
Effects: Allies within 10 ft gain +1 Initiative for 1 step.
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) → Stand-Alone: Accelerate/Hasten (+1 Initiative = 4).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Self (1), Shape Radius 10 ft (3), Duration Combat Step (2).
Notes/Special Conditions: Mandatory audible beat (chant, clap, or drum) to sustain the pulse; quieted or gagged casters cannot use this version.
Flavor Line: “The ember glows, and all step quicker to the fight.”

Name: Stoke the Line
Effects: Allies in area gain +5% to rolls and +1 damage for 1 round.
Container Breakdown: Containers: AoE (2) → Stand-Alone: Buff (+5% = 2) + Buff (+1 damage = 2).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Short (4); Shape Radius 10 ft (3) + size increase (+2) = 5; Duration Combat Round (5).
Notes/Special Conditions: Novice notes: (1) Affects allies only; (2) Morale bonus does not stack with identical Anger buffs; (3) The chant is audible—silence effects shut it down; (4) Overconfidence risk: G.O.D. may call for Discipline/Will checks if players roleplay recklessness.
Flavor Line: “Heat the metal, don’t melt it.”

Name: Incendiary Rebuke
Effects: Target suffers –10% to rolls and –1 Initiative for 1 round.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) → Stand-Alone: Debuff (–10% = 2 +1 = 3) + Stand-Alone: Decelerate/Slow (–1 Init = 4).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Medium (5); Duration Combat Round (5).
Notes/Special Conditions: Novice notes: (1) Ineffective on mindless targets; (2) If target roleplays goaded fury, G.O.D. may grant them +1 damage on a hit that round; (3) Can break Concentration checks at G.O.D.’s discretion; (4) Does not include Control—no forced actions.
Flavor Line: “Let pride do the rest.”

Name: Sweeping Roar
Effects: Enemies in a 30-ft cone are pushed 10 ft and must save or be knocked prone.
Container Breakdown: Containers: AoE (2) + Control (2) → inside Control: Push (3) + Knockdown (4).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Self (1); Shape Cone 30 ft (3); Duration Instantaneous (1).
Notes/Special Conditions: Novice notes: (1) Large or anchored foes may gain advantage to resist; (2) Friendly fire on allies in cone at G.O.D. discretion; (3) Does not move targets beyond terrain barriers; (4) If used near ledges, apply fall rules normally.
Flavor Line: “Make space. Take space.”

Name: Battle Hymn of Fury
Effects: Allies in area gain +10% accuracy and +2 damage for 2 rounds.
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) → Stand-Alone: Buff (+10% = 3) + Buff (+2 dmg = 3).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Medium (5); Shape Radius 30 ft (7); Duration 2 Combat Rounds (10).
Notes/Special Conditions: Morale effect—ineffective on creatures immune to emotional influence. Effects stack with physical buffs but not with other morale-based Anger buffs.
Flavor Line: “The hymn beats like war drums in every chest.”

Name: Vexing Aria
Effects: Enemies in cone suffer –10% rolls and –2 Initiative for 1 round.
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) → Stand-Alone: Debuff (–10% = 3) + Stand-Alone: Decelerate/Slow (–2 Init = 5).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Short (4); Shape Cone 30 ft (3); Duration Combat Round (5).
Notes/Special Conditions: Stacks with fear-based debuffs but not with other Anger accuracy debuffs. Sound must be audible.
Flavor Line: “A song that replaces thought with fury.”

Name: Ragequake
Effects: All creatures in 40 ft must save or be knocked prone; on fail, also pushed 10 ft.
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) + Control (2) → inside Control: Knockdown (4) + Push (3).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Self (1); Shape Sphere 40 ft (8); Duration Instantaneous (1).
Notes/Special Conditions: Large or flying foes may gain advantage to resist; indoor spaces may collapse fragile objects.
Flavor Line: “The ground itself answers my fury.”

Name: Wrath Unleashed
Effects: Allies in sphere gain +15% to rolls, +3 damage, and +2 Initiative for 3 rounds; Lingering: allies keep +5% for 1 extra step. Enemies in the same sphere suffer –10% to rolls and –2 Initiative for 3 rounds.
Container Breakdown: Containers: (1) AoE (2) → Buffs: +15% (4), +3 dmg (4), +2 Init (5). (2) Control (2) → inside: Debuff –10% (3) + Decelerate –2 Init (5).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Long (7); Shape Sphere 60 ft (11); Duration 3 Combat Rounds (15) + Lingering 1 step (2).
Modifiers: Modifier: Backlash Risk (–5; at the end of each round the bard saves or loses 1 HP/energy from overexertion).
Notes/Special Conditions: Allies may roleplay reckless pressure; G.O.D. can call Discipline checks to avoid overcommit. Sound must be audible. Morale bonuses don’t stack with other Anger morale effects.
Flavor Line: “The roar that turns fighters into fire—and foes into cinders of doubt.”

Name: Seismic Fury
Effects: Enemies in sphere take 9 damage and must save or be knocked prone; on fail also pushed 10 ft. Lingering (3 steps): the area becomes a Spatial Bubble of unstable footing and hostile pressure; enemies in the zone suffer –10% to rolls while it persists.
Container Breakdown: Containers: AoE (2) + Control (2) → inside Control: Knockdown (4) + Push 10 ft (3) + Debuff –10% (3) + Stand-Alone Damage 9 (3 + 8×2 = 19). + Stand-Alone: Spatial Bubble (8) to create the lingering zone.
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range Self (1); Shape Sphere 60 ft (11); Duration Instantaneous (1) + Lingering 3 steps (6).
Modifiers: Modifiers: Backlash Risk (–5; caster loses 1 step on a failed save) + Environmental Dependency (–3; reduced effect on solid stone/metal flooring).
Notes/Special Conditions: Doesn’t move targets through solid barriers; flying/anchored foes may gain advantage to resist control; debris may create difficult terrain at G.O.D. discretion.
Flavor Line: “The ground answers with a wrath all its own.”

Name: Rage Dominion
Effects: Allies gain +20% rolls, +4 damage, and +3 Initiative for 3 rounds (lingering +5% rolls for 2 extra steps). Enemies suffer –20% rolls and –3 Initiative for 3 rounds. On cast, enemies must save or be Stunned/Dazed for 1 step and may be knocked prone. The zone becomes a Spatial Bubble: movement impeded and temporal stutters may freeze actions.
Container Breakdown: • AoE (2) → Buff +20% (5), Buff +4 dmg (6), Accelerate +3 Init (6), Debuff –20% (8), Decelerate –3 Init (6). • Control (2) → Stun/Daze (6), Knockdown (4). • Temporal/Spatial (5) → Spatial Bubble (8), Temporal Stasis (6).
Add ons: Add-Ons: Line of Sight (10), Sphere 100 ft (32), Duration 3 Rounds (15), Lingering 2 steps (4).
Modifiers: Modifiers: Backlash Risk (–5), Per Success Assignment (+3), Component Requirement (–2).
Notes/Special Conditions: • Grand Master effect; immune/mindless targets may resist morale effects. • Anger morale buffs don’t stack with other Anger sources. • Spatial Bubble creates difficult footing (movement –5 ft). • Temporal Stasis: entering/exiting zone may trigger a save to avoid losing 1 step (1/round). • Flying/anchored foes gain advantage vs. Knockdown; Push limited by terrain. • Casting in magical silence/vacuum fails unless percussion is used. • On Backlash fail, bard also suffers –1 Initiative next step. • Fragile terrain may collapse inside zone.
Flavor Line: “The world marches to my fury.”

Name: Resonant Shiver
Effects: Deals 1 damage to object.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) + Stand Alone: Damage (1 = 3)
Add ons: Range: Short (4), Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Damage applied directly to object HP. • Fragile materials (glass, pottery, crystal) typically destroyed at G.O.D. discretion. • Audible ringing alerts others nearby.
Flavor Line: A note that makes glass surrender and steel remember it can shake.

Name: Quantum Hum
Effects: Applies –5% penalty to rolls for 1 step.
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Debuff (–5% = 2)
Add ons: Range: Self (1), Shape: Radius 10 ft (3), Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Debuff applies to all creatures in radius, ally or enemy. • Penalty fades once vibrations subside. • Described as a faint “engine-room” resonance.
Flavor Line: The hum beneath reality’s skin.

Name: Tuning Note
Effects: Heals 1 HP and grants +5% to next roll.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) + Stand Alone: Healing (1 = 3) + Stand Alone: Buff (+5% = 2)
Add ons: Range: Touch (2), Duration: Instantaneous (1)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Healing minor wounds only; cannot restore lost limbs. • Buff applies only to the very next roll. • Requires bard’s direct focus/touch.
Flavor Line: A note that realigns body and soul into harmony.

Name: Harmonic Lattice
Effects: Alters movement/pressure within a small zone (difficult movement feel; no damage).
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Spatial Bubble (8)
Add ons: Range: Self (1); Shape: Radius (10 ft) (3); Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Affects all creatures/objects in the radius equally (ally and enemy). • Counts as an altered-movement zone; G.O.D. adjudicates edge cases (flying, burrowing). • Does not deal damage or apply numerical penalties by itself; it modifies the medium of movement. • Pairs well with ally positioning or choke points.
Flavor Line: “Make the air thick and their choices slow.”

Name: Dissonant Disarm
Effects: Force the target to drop a held item.
Container Breakdown: Container: Control (2) + Control: Disarm (5)
Add ons: Range: Short (30 ft) (4); Duration: Instantaneous (1)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Targets one creature holding a discrete item. • If multiple held items, G.O.D. selects most threatened/active unless specified. • Dropped item falls per normal rules; no damage inflicted by this spell.
Flavor Line: “A single wrong note and the sword forgets its purpose.”

Name: Chord of Coherence
Effects: Allies in the radius gain +10% to rolls for 1 step; hidden details/energies are revealed or detected within the same area.
Container Breakdown: Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Buff (+10% = 3) + Stand Alone: Reveal/Detect (4)
Add ons: Range: Self (1); Shape: Radius (10 ft) (3); Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Buff applies to allies only; Reveal/Detect applies area-wide and is not limited to allies. • G.O.D. defines what “hidden” means in context (sounds, seams, faint auras). • Effects vanish when the tone ends; no lingering numerical bonuses remain. • Combines best with coordinated pushes or trap-spotting.
Flavor Line: “Hold the note and watch the world snap into focus.”

Name: Resonant Shatter
Effects: Primary object takes 3 sonic damage; fragile nearby objects may shatter.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) + Stand Alone: Damage (3 dmg = 9) + Nested Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Create/Destroy (basic breakage = 5)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5); Shape: Radius 10 ft (3); Duration: Combat Round (5)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Primary target is most affected (direct damage). • Fragile items in 10 ft radius may fail at G.O.D. discretion. • Allies’ items safe unless ruled otherwise.
Flavor Line: “One note, and the cracks spread from the heart outward.”

Name: Harmonic Shielding
Effects: Primary ally gains +2 soak; companions within 15 ft also gain +1 soak.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) + Stand Alone: Buff (+2 soak = 6) + Nested Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Buff (+1 soak = 2) + Stand Alone: Spatial Bubble (8)
Add ons: Range: Short (4); Shape: Radius 15 ft (5); Duration: Combat Round (5)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Target ally is anchor; effect diminishes with distance. • Barrier drops if anchor ally is silenced or incapacitated. • Stacks poorly with other soak-based buffs.
Flavor Line: “A harmony anchored in one soul, shared with all nearby.”

Name: Quantum Chorus
Effects: Target suffers –2 Initiative; nearby foes –1 Initiative; allies in same sphere gain +1 Initiative.
Container Breakdown: Container: Control (2) + Control: Decelerate/Slow (–2 Init = 8) + Nested Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Decelerate/Slow (–1 Init = 4) + Stand Alone: Accelerate/Hasten (+1 Init = 4)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5); Shape: Sphere 20 ft (5); Duration: Combat Step (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Primary target staggered hardest; ripple weaker on others. • Allies benefit equally inside zone. • Works only while bard sustains the chorus.
Flavor Line: “Voices overlap, and one enemy’s stumble sets the rhythm for all.”

Name: Fracture of the Infinite
Effects: Target suffers 10 sonic damage; all objects/creatures within 30 ft suffer 5 sonic damage and fragile materials collapse.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) + Stand Alone: Damage (10 dmg = 21) + Nested Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Damage (5 dmg = 11) + Stand Alone: Create/Destroy (major collapse = 12)
Add ons: Range: Medium (5); Shape: Sphere 30 ft (8); Duration: Combat Round (5) + Lingering (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Main target takes full brunt of resonance. • Fragile materials in the AoE automatically collapse. • Lingering step continues minor vibration damage (1d2 sonic). • Extremely loud; stealth impossible.
Flavor Line: “A crack in the song, and the world sings itself apart.”

Name: Symphony of Alignment
Effects: Allies gain +20% to rolls and +2 Initiative; enemies in zone suffer –20% rolls and –2 Initiative.
Container Breakdown: Container: Control (2) + Stand Alone: Buff (+20% = 5) + Stand Alone: Accelerate/Hasten (+2 Init = 5) + Nested Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Debuff (–20% = 5) + Stand Alone: Decelerate/Slow (–2 Init = 5)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10); Shape: Sphere 40 ft (11); Duration: Combat Round (5) + Lingering (2)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Allies and enemies equally affected in same zone. • Buff/debuffs are strong but brief; lingering extends the after-effect one step. • Requires bard to maintain tonal stability; silence cancels effects. • Risk: bard may suffer disorientation after casting (–5% to own rolls for 1 step).
Flavor Line: “When all notes align, no motion can escape the song.”

Name: Quantum Convergence
Effects: Primary target takes 15 sonic damage and suffers Immobilize. Enemies within sphere take 8 sonic damage each round and –2 Initiative. Allies within sphere gain +2 Initiative and +10% accuracy. Fragile materials collapse; reality in the zone stutters and detunes.
Container Breakdown: Container: Target (1) + Stand Alone: Damage (15 dmg = 31) + Control (2) + Stand Alone: Immobilize (6) + Nested Container: AoE (2) + Stand Alone: Damage (8 dmg = 17) + Stand Alone: Decelerate/Slow (–2 Init = 5) + Stand Alone: Accelerate/Hasten (+2 Init = 5) + Stand Alone: Buff (+10% = 3) + Stand Alone: Create/Destroy (major collapse = 12)
Add ons: Range: Line of Sight (10); Shape: Sphere 60 ft (17); Duration: 3 Combat Rounds (15) + Lingering 3 steps (6)
Modifiers: Backlash Risk (–5; caster risks phase-slip on failure)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Primary target is the anchor; suffers the brunt (damage + immobilize). • Zone deals ongoing damage and init penalties to enemies each round. • Allies inside gain initiative surge and accuracy. • Fragile matter collapses automatically (G.O.D. adjudicates edge cases). • Backlash: on casting failure the bard phase-slips and loses 1 round of actions. • Zone is audibly/visually impossible; stealth is not feasible. • Overlapping delicate magical effects may collapse or cancel at G.O.D. discretion.
Flavor Line: “The song aligns with itself, and the world cannot decide if it should exist.”

Name: Soul Lock
Effects: Binds multiple foes with spectral chains; restrained targets suffer Immobilize and –2 to all rolls until freed.
Container Breakdown: Container 1: AoE (2) → Stand Alone: Control (2) → Anchor/Lock (6) + Immobilize (6); Nested Container: Target (1) → Stand Alone: Link/Bind (6, soul tether)
Add ons: Add-Ons: Range: Medium (5); Shape: Cone (3); Duration: Combat Round (5); Multi-Target (3)
Notes/Special Conditions: • Targets may attempt Resolve checks each step to resist. • Binding ignores armor, striking at soul level. • If caster concentration is broken, chains collapse instantly. • Cannot affect constructs or mindless undead. • May provoke fear in allies witnessing its use.
Flavor Line: “Every soul has a chain—you need only find where it rattles.”
